coordinateConvention.space: Original glTF scene world before any engine wrapper, root includes original translation [.65,0,0], +X forward, +Y up, +Z source L arm
coordinateConvention.matrixLayout: Nested rows, row-major values; column-vector multiplication. Three Matrix4.fromArray needs flatten(column-major), or Matrix4.set(...row-major).
coordinateConvention.sideNaming: Exact original source joint names; source nativeL maps runtimeR according to retained source metadata. Do not silently swap named nodes.

applicationPolicy.animations: Disable every AnimationMixer action / Blender active action and NLA track before assigning all listed local TRS. Do not play original or new riding clip. Update world matrices.
applicationPolicy.morphs: Set ALL morph weights to zero on every mesh, including both gripClosed and every contactObservation. These equal source defaults.
applicationPolicy.correctiveApplicability: Existing corrective morphs are qualified only for their fixed riding trajectory. No seated/riding corrective is activated in these T/A diagnostics; exact parity is not generalized repair proof.
applicationPolicy.poseMechanism: Begin with exact source defaults. Rotate only upperArm.L, forearm.L, upperArm.R, forearm.R. For each chain, use a shortest-arc local rotation of the source joint frame to align its actual child-origin segment with the desired world direction, retaining source roll as much as this one-axis construction permits. Clavicles and hand relative rotations remain source default.
applicationPolicy.proportions: No translation, scale, inverse bind, weight, vertex or topology edit. Source local bone lengths remain exact. Tiny world length differences reflect retained near-unit anisotropic source scales and are recorded.
applicationPolicy.camera: Optional grounding/camera framing is separate from all matrices; use identical wrapper for source and candidate.
